symbols.name: The Path
symbols.meaning: A route that loops back. For those who return to the same place until the meaning shifts.

symbols.name: The Room
symbols.meaning: An enclosed space. It holds something without releasing it.
symbols.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 120 120' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><g fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M48 92 H28 V28 H92 V92 H72'/></g><circle cx='60' cy='60' r='8' fill='currentColor'/></svg>

symbols.name: The Threshold
symbols.meaning: The boundary between two states, made permanent on the body.
symbols.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 120 120' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><g fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M30 90 V34 H90 V90'/><path d='M20 90 H100'/><path d='M60 90 V58'/></g></svg>

symbols.name: The Eye
symbols.meaning: Witness. Something that sees and keeps seeing long after the moment passes.
symbols.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 120 120' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><g fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M16 60 Q60 26 104 60 Q60 94 16 60 Z'/><circle cx='60' cy='60' r='15'/></g><circle cx='60' cy='60' r='6' fill='currentColor'/></svg>

symbols.name: The Dot
symbols.meaning: The smallest unit of presence. A mark that says: I was here.
